source: 949 existing AI-generated digest Q&A paraphrases, Darryl Anka/Bashar context only
groupRule: Quarantine upload pairs connected by any identical normalized question, any question cosine >=0.80, or at least three question retrieval pairs at cosine >=0.40
groupCaveat: Source-family proxies are not verified original-session identities and cannot rule out unknown repost or pretraining overlap
ragIndex: Only the 48 selected training examples; heldout answer gists are never RAG evidence

ragRetrieval.method: word unigram/bigram English-stop-word sublinear TF-IDF, smooth IDF, L2 normalization

baseModel.interpretation: Small feasible CPU baseline, not established current state of the art

metrics.tokenOverlapF1: Multiset lowercase alphanumeric token overlap with heldout AI-generated answer gist; no factual-correctness inference
metrics.citationMembership: Output contains a supplied [D1]/[D2] label; syntactic membership only, not entailment
metrics.unsupportedControlAbstention: Exact INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE marker on two questions requiring absent studio-temperature or unpublished audio-hash evidence
metrics.latency: Wall-clock generation/response time on this shared CPU machine, not a hardware benchmark ranking

currentFamilyFeasibility: Inspect official Qwen3/Qwen3.5 metadata and attempt a separate Qwen3.5-0.8B text-only smoke test after verified downloads; no global SOTA or image capability claim
gpuComparison: Unsupported on this machine: no CUDA device exposed. Do not manufacture GPU throughput or GPU training metrics.
